currentScope: Ask for 3D + 2D renders or 2D sprites when unspecified; interaction and sitting do not require a furniture mesh. The sofa pilot uses unchanged original 2D art.

seat.actor: Native unscaled actor docks at a reserved seat; correct facing, arm/pillow clearance and safe exit.
seat.geometry: Native seat sockets, foreground and collision share the sprite anchor or chosen model pivot.
acceptance: Two actors cannot claim the same slot.
Stand, cancel, disconnect and removal release occupancy.
Rotation/style changes preserve item identity and valid contacts.
seat.releaseVia: interaction.cancel / leave; stand and wake are user-facing meanings, not new backend actions.

rest.actor: Actor sleep/rest pose docks to the bed, with blanket/foreground allowance and a reachable wake exit.
rest.geometry: Bed remains solid and occupied slot cannot be double-booked.
acceptance: Wake/cancel restores walking and frees the slot.
Neither actor scaling nor clipping may hide bad fit.
rest.releaseVia: interaction.cancel / leave; stand and wake are user-facing meanings, not new backend actions.

light.actor: Approach a reachable side; use existing short interaction, then return to idle.
light.geometry: Switching light does not change furniture collision.
acceptance: Off removes flame/emission rather than only tinting the whole sprite.
Reload and other clients resolve the same server-owned lit state.
Repeated completion of the same actionId cannot toggle twice.
Keep reduced-motion glow steady.
light.artRoute: Native 2D off/on sprites with optional flame/glow; no mesh required.

door.actor: Approach outside the sweep; preserve current owner permission.
door.geometry: Only the doorway passage opens; frame remains solid. Refuse closure on an actor/pet.
acceptance: Closed blocks and open permits the actual doorway.
Rotation projects the hinge, frame and passage consistently.
Do not apply door-style collision removal to a future open cabinet or refrigerator.

food.actor: Approach bowl edge; spend an available housing food supply once.
food.geometry: Distinct feed/animal access remains reachable; no seating socket.
acceptance: 0 is empty, 1-2 partial, 3 full using the same geometry across level states.
Full/duplicate requests consume no extra supplies.
Pet consumption reduces the same authoritative counter.

water.actor: Approach bowl edge; spend an available housing water supply once.
water.geometry: Keep bowl/base collision independent of water level.
acceptance: 0 is empty, 1-2 partial, 3 full.
Refill, consumption, duplicate requests and reconnect use the same counter.

care_station.actions: Existing per-item fill_food/fill_water; double tray adds planned independent fill_water support.
care_station.persistent: Same food/water counters and timestamps as bowl contracts, scoped to the placed item.
care_station.actor: Use separate safe approaches for each resource; do not consume both supplies for one action.
care_station.geometry: Keep feeder/fountain/stand structure and animal access meaningful.
acceptance: Preserve per-item capabilities; do not make a feeder a water source by accident.
Double tray keeps food and water independent; its current catalog only declares fill_food.
Do not add electricity, daily income or reward mechanics.

climb.actor: Invite an eligible cat; reuse existing native cat rig and capability/species limits.
climb.geometry: Surface height, capacity, landing bounds, approach and descent share the model transform.
acceptance: Occupied surfaces cannot receive a second incompatible pet.
Rotation/removal invalidates stale surfaces and provides safe descent.

actions: pet autonomous perch/rest; encourage_climb only where already declared
perch.actor: Cat uses existing species-limited surface lease; these are not human seats.
perch.geometry: Reachable top/rest surface with landing allowance and descent; retain the actual native actor scale.
acceptance: A surface declaration needs a reachable approach and usable landing.
Do not introduce a human sit action on coffee tables or cat beds.

plant.actor: Reach pot edge and consume an actual housing water supply once.
plant.geometry: Simple solid pot/trunk; separate sprite foliage and sensor.
acceptance: Watered/recent visual derives from wateredAt; do not invent stored growth or decay.
Ignore/reject generic door actions on plants.

soft_contact.actor: Walking/running applies a bounded impulse; reduced motion settles it.
soft_contact.geometry: Soft sensor independent of any solid structure; static window art does not create a passage.
acceptance: Keep native 2D artwork and authored facing.
Restore rest pose after contact/teleport; never sway the whole room.

aquarium_care.actor: Reach the existing care approach and consume the existing housing care supply once.
aquarium_care.geometry: Keep the installed tank/cabinet footprint and bounded fish layers.
acceptance: Reuse existing source model; no remodelling implied.
Care timestamps/cooldown remain authoritative; fish phase is transient presentation.

catalogCorrections.issue: Catalog declares rest and one human seat on a small cabinet.
catalogCorrections.plan: Remove the copied bed action/socket and leave as 2D inspection-only for now; storage interactions stay deferred.
Remove the door action; hold conversion until a proper water_plant approach/supply contract is implemented.
Remove the door action; hold conversion until a proper water_plant approach/supply contract is implemented.

existingModelReview.work: Preserve source models; review current seat/perch/cloth/fish/care integrations when executing the relevant family.
existingModelReview.note: Bookshelf stays installed even though it is inspection-only; do not delete prior work.
